events.title: NIDARAVE 2026
events.description: NIDARAVE 2026 TECH HOUSE - PSY TECH - TECHNO Saturday, September 19th, 2026 20:00 - 02:15 Trondheim Spektrum -- Hall F Club-Wonderland Events returns to Trondheim Spektrum with NIDARAVE 2026, the next evolution of one of the city's most ambitious techno events. After writing a new chapter in 2025, we're back in Hall F for another massive night, pushing the concept even further. This is once again the largest event we've produced since Club-Wonderland began in 1999 - refined, expanded and driven by the crowd. What to expect? More intensity. More space. More pressure. We're building Trondheim's most immersive techno experience, right in the center of Hall F, with a maximum capacity of 3,000 ravers. Doors open at 20:00. You enter a tight, focused dancefloor that grows with the energy in the room. What starts intimate and raw gradually unfolds into a full-scale rave as the night progresses. LINEUP COZ PLAY - Faia - NoModE - PureGroove - go_chi Check the artist profiles at https://clubbing.no/event/nidarave-2026-trondheim/ ID: 18+ attitude Doors: 20:00 Trondheim Spektrum -- Hall F By your demand, we'll expand. NIDARAVE is built by the crowd. The dancefloor expands as the crowd grows, so join the RAVE and get your tickets now! How big will NIDARAVE get in 2026? Early Bird tickets are sold out. Batch 3 tickets are still available. WANT TO SUPPORT NIDARAVE? NIDARAVE grows through the support of the people who want events like this to happen. Here are a few simple ways you can help: BUY YOUR TICKET EARLY If you already know you want to attend, buying your ticket early is one of the most valuable ways to support the event. Early ticket sales give us predictability and make it easier to plan production, staffing, security and logistics with confidence. Read more about why early ticket sales matter: https://clubbing.no/news/support-the-scene-why-buying-your-ticket-early-matters/ ON FACEBOOK Tap Interested -- and Going if you plan to attend. Invite friends who might enjoy NIDARAVE and share the event. ON INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK Like, comment, share and repost our content. Tag your friends, share NIDARAVE in your stories or create your own reels and videos to help spread the word. PUT UP A POSTER Download the official event poster from Clubbing.no, print it and put it up at your workplace, school, gym or anywhere else it feels appropriate and is permitted. Event information, tickets and poster: https://clubbing.no/event/nidarave-2026-trondheim/ Every ticket, invite, share and poster makes a difference. Thank you for helping us build NIDARAVE! Other Club-Wonderland events 2026: 17. oktober OASEN @ TEKNOSTALLEN ID:20 https://clubbing.no/event/oasen/ 14. november TRØNDERDOME @ Lager11 ID:18 https://clubbing.no/event/tronderdome/ 26. desember CLUB-WONDERLAND @ Lager11 ID:18 https://clubbing.no/event/club-wonderland/ Subscribe to our newsletter at https://club-wonderland.com See you in Wonderland
